name: @zhizhu/biz-account-auth-status
description: 抖音员工授权 confer 列表 auth_status 归一化（客户端组行、API 入库、Web 展示共用）

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const hasTsc=(()=>{try{return !!require.resolve('typescript/bin/tsc')}catch{return false}})();if(!hasTsc){console.log('[biz-account-auth-status] skip build: typescript not installed');process.exit(0);}cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});"
